gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same failed uniform-feasibility argument: negating simultaneous vector feasibility permits a component index depending on y and k, but the proof incorrectly fixes one component j before quantifying over all y and k. It also identifies the resulting invalid MFCQ contradiction.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: Both entries concern the proof of the uniform Slater conclusion and the unjustified interchange of the component existential quantifier with the quantifiers over y and k. The resulting single-component MFCQ argument cannot establish uniform vector feasibility.

component_coverage.gold_component: The negation of simultaneous vector feasibility only yields a possibly varying violating component, so the proof cannot select one fixed component for all y and k; consequently the single-component MFCQ contradiction does not establish the uniform Slater constant.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly states the simultaneous componentwise conclusion, derives the y-dependent violating index, identifies the unjustified upgrade to a fixed j, and explains that the remaining limit/MFCQ contradiction depends on that invalid claim.
